mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 1) AS active, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 2) AS frozen, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 3) AS expired, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 4) AS cancelled, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.isolation_mode <> 1) AS isolated, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.plan_id IS NOT NULL AND t.plan_id <> #{freePlanId}) AS paid, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE date_trunc('month', t.create_time) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)) AS new_this_month FROM tenant t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count), 0) AS requests, COALESCE(SUM(u.rejected_count), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(SUM(u.session_count), 0) AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(u.ai_call_count), 0) AS ai_calls FROM tenant_usage_daily u JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_code = u.tenant_code AND t.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE u.stat_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', t.create_time), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(1) AS new_tenants FROM tenant t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.create_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - make_interval(months => #{months} - 1) GROUP BY date_trunc('month', t.create_time) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', t.create_time)
SELECT t.plan_id AS plan_id, COUNT(1) AS tenant_count FROM tenant t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY t.plan_id ORDER BY tenant_count DESC, t.plan_id
SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(1) AS tenant_count FROM tenant t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status

SELECT t.tenant_code AS tenant_code, e.company_name AS company_name, t.status AS status, t.plan_id AS plan_id, COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count), 0) AS month_requests, COALESCE(SUM(u.session_count), 0) AS month_sessions FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN tenant_usage_daily u ON u.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND u.stat_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY t.tenant_code, e.company_name, t.status, t.plan_id, t.create_time ORDER BY month_requests DESC, t.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.tenant_code AS tenant_code, e.company_name AS company_name, e.industry AS industry, t.plan_id AS plan_id, t.status AS status, t.expire_time AS expire_time, t.create_time AS create_time, COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count), 0) AS month_requests, COALESCE(SUM(u.session_count), 0) AS month_sessions, MAX(u.stat_date) AS last_active_date FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN tenant_usage_daily u ON u.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND u.stat_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date WHERE
GROUP BY t.tenant_code, e.company_name, e.industry, t.plan_id, t.status, t.expire_time, t.create_time ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.tenant_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
